messages:
Mia Chen: Quick sync — we need a runbook + deploy flow for the Datadog OTLP adapter in Private (VPC/on-prem) and the HW Marketplace tile. Goal: ship docs + sample dashboards for SI onboarding next week. Who can own which pieces?

Samir Patel: I can own the runbook + packaging for the air-gapped collector image. Main blockers: image signing + manifest for offline installs, plus a minimal helm/manifest for non-k8s on-prem. ETA: EOD Thu for a first draft. :clock4:

Jordan Lee: I'll take dashboards + example traces. Plan to create a lightweight Grafana/Datadog dashboard set and a small sample app that emits spans. Need sample trace payloads and expected tags from Datadog ingest.

Ava (Datadog): Happy to help. Minimal OTLP config we recommend for Private:```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
processors:
  batch:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      site: "https://api.datadoghq.com"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```Link: https://docs.datadoghq.com/tracing/otlp/ — we'll provide a sample env var set for site/api key that works in VPC mode.

Lia (Sumatra SI): For SI onboarding, we need a clear example of trace sampling and resource tags (customer_id, cluster, hw_profile). Also want a short runbook step for validating traffic (curl + local OTLP sender) and a checklist for firewall rules outbound to Datadog.

Samir Patel: Good call. I'll add a "validation" section with a small curl + otelcol command:```bash
# send a test span
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://local-otlp:4317 \
OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES="service.name=simple-app,customer_id=demo" \
./otel-emit --trace
```And a quick tcpdump / netcat example for firewall debug.

Jordan Lee: For dashboards, I'll include two small views: 1) trace latency waterfall with host/hw_profile filter, 2) cold-start GPU kernel timing (sample spans from model init). Will attach sample JSON trace payloads and a DD dashboard json that SIs can import.

Ava (Datadog): We'll supply a pre-made dashboard tile and a Datadog monitor template for trace error rate. Also can share recommended tags: `customer_id`, `deployment_env`, `machine_type`, `gpu_model`, `rt_latency_ms`.

Mia Chen: Great — owners: Samir = runbook + airgap packaging, Jordan = dashboards + sample traces, Ava = Datadog artifacts & tags, Lia = SI checklist + firewall items. Deliverables due: draft runbook + dashboards by Fri, internal demo Tue next week. Can everyone ack? :white_check_mark:

Samir Patel: Ack.

Jordan Lee: Ack — will post dashboard JSON in the repo by Thu.

Ava (Datadog): Ack. I'll upload the dashboard tile to the shared GDrive.

Lia (Sumatra SI): Ack. I'll prepare an SI playbook PDF and a short checklist for on-prem install.

deploy-bot: build/redwood-otel-adapter:release 2174056 -> succeeded :tada: (artifact: https://ci.example.com/builds/2174056)

Mia Chen: Nice — Samir, after you have the image signing steps, add the exact hash & where to verify. Jordan, once you drop the dashboards, I'll schedule a 30m demo with Sumatra for Wed. Thanks all!
